label: TypeScript and JavaScript mutation testing (Stryker)
description: Mutation testing of TypeScript and JavaScript components with StrykerJS and the project's Stryker configuration, in a copy of the component inside the run folder. Comes in by evidence: only when a Stryker configuration (stryker.config.* or stryker.conf.*) exists or @stryker-mutator/core is a dependency; runs only where mutation is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Bounded to 15 minutes (timeoutSeconds 900): a run that exceeds it has no score. Stryker is the project's own dev dependency and is never installed during a run.
